adapter: Clone all four frozen V8 route scorers. Keep the V8 visual grounder and V5/V6 visual forecast frozen. Fit for exactly ten epochs, seed 101, AdamW 0.0003, weight decay 0.015, gradient cap 3, parameter anchoring 0.5. Equal minibatch mass from the eight congruent training layouts of four Blender houses and natural HSSD training primitives sampled uniformly from the original 12 houses. Retain all three action horizons, including ties. No model or checkpoint selection.
test: Two held Blender houses, both sides, both box swaps. Score all congruent, hidden and conflicting modes separately after freezing. Hidden and conflicting are never used to fit any head. Full blind reversal and binary directional accuracy are evaluated using the same history mask under a swap. When both layouts render exactly the same past RGB and actions, direction changes cannot be inferred from that input. The third natural HSSD panel is scored a second time using this fixed laboratory adapter, explicitly shared across V8 and the adapter. No additional paid rollout or claim of an additional independent HSSD panel.
